# Mistletoe Construction LLC

> Family-owned roofing and construction company serving Roseburg and all of Douglas County, Oregon. Licensed Oregon contractor (CCB #255729) and Owens Corning contractor. Services: roof replacement, roof repair, metal roofing, moss removal, siding, gutters, storm damage, and a monthly Home Care Membership starting at $49/month. Phone: (541) 670-5005. Based in Riddle, OR 97469.

Mistletoe Construction is a local, family-owned roofing and general construction company in the Umpqua Valley of southern Oregon. We handle the wet, mossy Pacific Northwest climate that shortens roof life in Douglas County, and we offer a membership program that maintains roofs proactively (annual inspections, seasonal debris checks, priority scheduling, emergency tarping). All work is done by our own crews — licensed, bonded, and insured in Oregon.
